preflight_dedup.reason: P125 covers cargo identity/traceability, P128 condition survey and representativeness, P130 storage/inventory, and P133 landside handoff. None separately models a terminal dry-bulk quantity/weight measurement plus sampling/quality and custody-reconciliation confidence boundary, while generic scope, documentation, observation, monitoring and lifecycle mechanics are already represented.

new_categories.label: terminal_dry_bulk_quantity_measurement_service_readiness
new_categories.memory: Terminal dry-bulk quantity or weight measurement can be represented as a delivered assurance service-state distinct from cargo identity, storage inventory and physical transfer-path availability, without retaining exact instrument type, quantity, tolerance or method.

new_categories.label: measurement_basis_scope_confidence
new_categories.memory: Confidence can attach to a bounded measurement basis or transfer scope without asserting a specific scale, draft-survey method, calculation convention, calibration state, unit or contractual basis.

new_categories.label: sampling_opportunity_readiness
new_categories.memory: A terminal can have a distinct opportunity/readiness state for obtaining a sample at an appropriate handoff or cargo-flow scope without retaining sampler design, location, frequency or procedure.

new_categories.label: sampling_representativeness_confidence
new_categories.memory: Sample availability is not equivalent to confidence that the sample represents the bounded lot or flow; representativeness can remain a separate qualitative state without exact statistical or procedural claims.

new_categories.label: quality_condition_scope_alignment_confidence
new_categories.memory: Quality or condition observations can be bounded to the sampled or measured cargo scope and need not imply the whole stockpile, parcel, vessel or contractual cargo condition.

new_categories.label: custody_handoff_measurement_confidence
new_categories.memory: A cargo handoff can carry a distinct confidence state that quantity/quality measurement is sufficiently aligned with the custody boundary, without asserting title transfer, legal custody, exact documents or commercial terms.

new_categories.label: measurement_provenance_chain_confidence
new_categories.memory: Measurement confidence can depend on a traceable chain linking bounded cargo scope, observation/measurement event and resulting record, while exact identifiers, certificates or document contents remain deferred.

new_categories.label: quantity_inventory_reconciliation_confidence
new_categories.memory: Measured receipt/dispatch quantity and storage/inventory confidence can diverge; reconciliation confidence is therefore distinct from either measurement availability or inventory-location readiness alone.

new_categories.label: measurement_sampling_independent_check_confidence
new_categories.memory: An independent or alternate check can be represented abstractly as corroboration confidence without naming surveyors, laboratories, instruments, methods or contractual authority.

new_categories.label: measurement_sampling_monitoring_indication_confidence
new_categories.memory: Monitoring or indication supporting measurement/sampling readiness can degrade separately from the underlying cargo flow or storage service without exact system or alarm claims.

new_categories.label: measurement_sampling_support_dependency_confidence
new_categories.memory: Staffing, instrument availability, communications, power, laboratory access or other support dependency can affect measurement/sampling assurance without retaining exact provider or dependency topology.

new_categories.label: measurement_sampling_degradation_restriction_isolation_restoration_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: The assurance service can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, under-restoration and restored states while the physical cargo path remains separately available or unavailable.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_measurement_reconciliation_restoration
new_categories.memory: Instrument/service return, sampling opportunity, representativeness confidence, record alignment, reconciliation and restriction release may recover at different times rather than one synthetic restoration timestamp.

useful_refinements.label: quantity_measurement_vs_cargo_identity_traceability
useful_refinements.memory: P125 identity/lot/parcel traceability can establish what cargo scope is being discussed but not how much cargo was measured or whether measurement was available.

useful_refinements.label: sampling_quality_vs_damage_condition_survey
useful_refinements.memory: P128 survey/observation and condition representativeness do not by themselves establish a terminal sampling opportunity or quantity/quality measurement service.

useful_refinements.label: measured_quantity_vs_storage_inventory_confidence
useful_refinements.memory: P130 storage/inventory location and reclaim readiness do not make measured receipt/dispatch quantity equivalent to book or physical inventory confidence.

useful_refinements.label: measurement_custody_confidence_vs_handoff_path_readiness
useful_refinements.memory: P133 landside handoff readiness does not establish that quantity/quality measurement is aligned to the custody boundary; physical interchange and measurement assurance are separate states.

duplicates.label: generic_scope_observation_documentation_monitoring_support_lifecycle
duplicates.memory: Generic scope alignment, observation validity, record linkage, monitoring, support dependency, degradation, restriction, isolation and restoration repeat prior survey, identity and service-state families.

duplicates.label: generic_downstream_discrepancy_does_not_prove_measurement_root_cause
duplicates.memory: Inventory mismatch, cargo rejection, commercial dispute, rehandling, delay or schedule effects do not by themselves prove a scale, sample, survey or custody root cause; this causal-boundary rule is already campaign-wide.

stop_reason: The bounded terminal dry-bulk quantity/weight measurement, sampling/quality and custody-reconciliation questions are answered at structural Memory level. Further recall trends toward exact instruments, methods, values, tolerances, specifications, documents, contractual terms, providers or disputes that require Evidence or a different explicitly selected frontier.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only defensive terminal dry-bulk measurement/sampling/custody orientation and source-discovery output; not weighing, sampling, laboratory, custody-transfer, reconciliation, legal, commercial, maintenance or emergency guidance and not proof of any exact instrument, method, quantity, tolerance, specification, document, term, provider, dispute, incident or current-readiness fact.
